title: [HD] Children of Men - Ark of the Arts - "I just don't think about it"
summary: A scene from Children of Men in which Theo visits Nigel in the Ark of the Arts to get transit papers. It features Nigel's line "I just don't think about it" and a one-handed chorded keyboard.
why: HN cites it as a film example of chorded input devices and as an analogy for wealthy indifference to suffering.

quote.text: I imagine something like this clip from Children of Men could work
